item.title: Version 1.8.4
item.description:
Updating from an older version? This one needs a one-time manual install. Click Learn More to download it, open the file, and drag Tood into Applications. Future updates will install automatically again.

  • Press Tab to tuck a to-do under the one above it. Shift-Tab pulls it back out.
  • To-dos can now start with a dash
  • Fixed iPhone edits sometimes being overwritten by the Mac
  • Settings now shows which Google account is connected

item.title: Version 1.8.3
item.description:
Updating from an older version? This one needs a one-time manual install. Click Learn More to download it, open the file, and drag Tood into Applications. Future updates will install automatically again.

  • Tood now sends anonymous usage stats and crash reports to help us improve it. Never what you write. Turn it off any time in Settings → Privacy. Details in the privacy policy.
  • Backspace on an empty item now deletes it

item.title: Version 1.8.2
item.description:
Updating from an older version? This one needs a one-time manual install. Click Learn More to download it, open the file, and drag Tood into Applications. Future updates will install automatically again.

  • Fixed a sticky sometimes shrinking to nothing when adding new items
  • 'Show less' now shows the full six items it promises

item.title: Version 1.8.1
item.description:
Updating from an older version? This one needs a one-time manual install. Click Learn More to download it, open the file, and drag Tood into Applications. Future updates will install automatically again.

  • Fixed sticky windows sometimes not shrinking back down after being resized wider
  • Control+1…0 jumps straight to any of your first ten stickies
  • Checklists edit more like a real text editor: split/merge lines with Return/Backspace, arrow keys move between the title and items
  • Checking off an item now has a small animation, plus ⌘Z/⌘⇧Z to undo/redo completions
  • Archived stickies now browse right on the Home screen instead of a separate window — click to restore, right-click to delete for good
  • Drag and drop to reorder your stickies on Home
  • Stickies can now sync across your devices via iCloud
  • Fixed automatic updates themselves failing with "An error occurred while launching the installer" for some users

item.title: Version 1.7.0
item.description:
• New "Report a Bug…" in the status menu: text + optional screenshot, sent straight to feedback
  • Fixed the report form's cursor showing the app's green accent instead of a neutral color
  • Support for occasional in-app announcements going forward
